description.text: International students are required to reach the language level (students for Chinese taught programs should pass HSK5 before graduation; students for English taught programs should pass HSK4 before graduation), complete the curriculum and fulfill the designated number of credits within the learning period. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with a bachelor’s degree, according to the regulation of the Degree Committee.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Beijing Information of Science and Technology University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. The photocopy of passport(photo page and China visa page. Valid for more than one year); 2. One passport-size photo with a white background; 3. Diploma: Copy of high school graduation certificate (recent graduates can provide a “pre-graduation certificate”, and submit a high school graduation certificate upon admission); 4. Transcripts: High school transcripts of all courses(recent graduates can provide existing transcripts and resubmit all transcripts upon admission); 5. Language proficiency: (1) Applicant for Chinese taught programs should provide the certificate of HSK level 4 or above (with total score over 180 points).Students without HSK level 4 certificate can first apply for the preppie program, and will directly be upgraded into bachelor degree program after passing HSK level 4 with one year’s Chinese language study. (2) Applicant for English taught programs(whose native language or official language is not English) must have English proficiency of IELTS 5.5 or above, or TOFEL(iBT) 68 or above, or other equivalent English ability qualifications , or pass the university’s English language proficiency test and doesn’t need to provide qualification about Chinese language ability. 6. Physical Examination Materials: If applicant applies from abroad, he must submit the scanned “Foreigner Physical Examination Form” within the validity period. If the applicant has already stayed in China, he must submit the scanned “Certificate of Verification(For Physical Examination Record for Foreigner or Overseas Chinese” (including the Physical Examination Report) within the validity period; 7. Proof of Economic Ability(proof of on-the-job income, bank deposits, or other proof of economic ability); 8. A complete “Beijing Information Science & Technology University (BISTU) Application Form for International Students” (Annex 1); 9. A complete “Beijing Information Science & Technology University (BISTU) Information Form for International Students’ Family Members”(Annex 2); 10. Copies of other awards; 11. Applicant who is under 18, must provide the original copy of the notarized legal guardian form issued by Notary Public Office in Beijing and the scanned passports of parents

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport and awarded certificate of graduation from high school or above and transcripts exhibiting satisfactory academic performance. 2. Between 18 and 30 years old. 3. In good physical and mental health, no criminal record.
